einzeiler: Jet lag disasters in Singapore, college football surprises, and fitness startup news.
kurzfassung: Hannah recounts her brutal jet lag and stomach troubles during a trip to Singapore, culminating in a midnight laxative crisis. Meanwhile, Paige attends a Miami college football game where she runs into celebrity friends and ends up on the Jumbotron with the cheerleaders. The hosts also discuss reality TV, snack preferences, and the launch of Hannah's new comedy workout video series.
stichpunkte: Hannah suffers from severe jet lag and digestive issues during an international trip to Singapore.
A four-hour Michelin-star tasting menu in Singapore turns into a sleep-deprived endurance test.
A midnight laxative mishap leads to a dramatic panic attack on the hotel bathroom floor.
Paige accidentally attends a college football game in Miami instead of a basketball game.
Paige gets spotted by Bethenny Frankel and invited to dance with the cheerleaders on the Jumbotron.
Hannah officially launches her new comedy-infused workout series called Gym Class.
The hosts debate various comfort foods, peanut butter brands, and heating appliances.

clips.text: A late-night decision to take a laxative triggers intense physical pain exactly as predicted, leading to immediate regret.

clips.hook: Should I go to the Singaporean hospital?
clips.text: Severe gastrointestinal distress in a foreign country prompts dramatic thoughts of abandoning the vacation entirely.
An unexpected invitation onto a stadium screen leaves the speaker improvising a dance routine without a drink in hand.
A long-held concept combining comedy and exercise is finally brought to life to help people laugh while getting fit.

beschreibung:
Paige joined a cheerleading team and Hannah realized she's not stronger than jet lag.
